Name: Emily for Stardew Impact
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14365/]Stardew Impact[/url]. It lets you play as Emily and gives her an elemental skill and burst ability.


[b][size=5]Elemental Skill[/size][/b]

Her elemental skill sends a parrot out in the direction of the mouse cursor to either a maximum distance set in the config or the first encountered monster.

The parrot then inflicts damage based on the damage of the currently equipped weapon on any monsters in its area of effect, striking five times.

The elemental skill can also cut grass and harvest crops in its area of effect.

Her elemental skill increases her burst energy by 20 each time it is cast and has a 5 second cooldown.


[b][size=5]Burst Skill[/size][/b]

Her burst skill causes four parrots to create a whirlwind in the direction of the mouse cursor at either a maximum distance set in the config or the first encountered monster.

The whirlwind draws monsters towards the center and deals damage based on the currently equipped weapon periodically until it ends.

The whirlwind can also cut grass and harvest crops in its area of effect.

Her burst skill requires 80 energy to cast and has a 10 second cooldown.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can edit the config.json file that is created when first running the game or use GMCM.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
